const review = $input.first().json;
const intake = $('Normalise Validated Intake').item.json;
const fields = review.extractedFields;
return [{ json: {
  submissionId: review.submissionId,
  submittedAt: intake.submittedAt,
  companyName: intake.companyName,
  website: intake.website,
  contactName: intake.contactName,
  contactEmail: intake.contactEmail,
  serviceRequested: intake.serviceRequested,
  desiredStartDate: intake.desiredStartDate,
  documentName: intake.documentName,
  extractedBudget: fields.budget,
  extractedTargetLaunchDate: fields.targetLaunchDate,
  extractedProjectSummary: fields.projectSummary,
  extractedDependencies: fields.dependencies,
  missingFields: review.missingFields.join(', '),
  reviewStatus: review.reviewStatus,
  reviewReason: review.reviewReason,
  followUpDraft: review.followUpDraft,
  approvalStatus: review.approvalStatus
} }];
